title: Malicious code in @rizzkezik/bailss (npm)
description: The npm package @rizzkezik/bailss version 1.2.0 includes a dependency on a GitHub repository for libsignal without pinning to a specific commit, tag, or version. This allows the repository owner to change the code at any time, potentially introducing malicious code during installation. The lack of integrity checks means the installed code is controlled by the third-party repository owner rather than the npm package publisher.
